h1: Empower Bhutanese Enterprise with Autonomous Cloud Agents

chapters.d: As mist settles over the Thimphu valley, your agents deliver consolidated overnight reports on international travel bookings and trade queries. You review the highlights directly on Telegram before the morning commute.

While you consult with partners along Norzin Lam, your browser agent compiles regional tender documentation and fills compliance forms. Meanwhile, your coding agent runs backend unit tests in its cloud environment.
Your team of specialist agents coordinates client inquiries from European and North American time zones automatically. Documents and financial summaries sync cleanly into your shared workspace.

Even after your laptop closes and your phone goes dark, your isolated cloud computer continues auditing live datasets and verifying system uptimes. Bhutan rests while your cloud workforce produces uninterrupted output.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost, and how does the free trial work?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your card is linked at registration and charged only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does Ceyo stay active when my computer or phone is offline in Bhutan?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot runs inside its own dedicated cloud computer, which continues browsing the web, executing code, and running scheduled routines 24/7 without requiring your local device to stay powered on or connected.

faq.q: Can I collaborate with my Ceyo agents inside Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact with personal bots directly via Telegram and introduce multiple specialized agents into group chats, allowing them to collaborate as an autonomous project team.

faq.q: What languages and external applications does Ceyo support?
faq.a: Ceyo communicates fluently in English and dozens of global languages, easily connecting to more than 1,000 tools including Gmail, Google Sheets, Notion, Slack, and standard cloud CRMs.

faq.q: How secure is my data inside Ceyo's cloud computer?
faq.a: Each bot functions in an isolated environment with dedicated storage and long-term memory, ensuring your business documents, automated browser workflows, and shared data remain strictly segregated and protected.
